title: El Bou Tradicional de Valls
notationNotes: Slurs are not ties; repeated pitches are reattacked.
Bar 4 contains an octave chord on the last eighth note.
Bars 17 and 46 are first endings; bars 18 and 47 are second endings.
Bar 93 is an alternative fire-loop return and is excluded from lluïment.
Tempo after Moderat, ritardando, fermatas and accelerando requires interpretation.

Bar 12, Gralla I, beat 3: B natural, not the printed B flat. The PDF misses the natural sign: the bass holds G (the dominant), Gralla II plays B naturals a third below in the same bar and live performances play B natural (Marc, 2026-10-24).
